compatibilityDecisions.decision: Retain installed Effect 4.0.2 and workspace compiler versions; publication uses the existing Content discovery implementation with native Schema, Context.Service and Layer APIs checked by package build, typecheck and deterministic tests.
compatibilityDecisions.limitation: Local installed compatibility only; no claim of newest version or external publication.

limitations: Structural rendering does not prove installed dependency, declaration, runtime, or packed-consumer behavior.
nonClaims: Selected versions are not claimed to remain latest.

changes: Use workspace catalogue dependency specifiers and source condition.
Keep authored page identities and immutable catalogue in Content; consume transport route vocabulary from HTTP.
